title: 終電フリースタイル
artist: ミッドナイト・キャンディ
caption: Late 1980s Japanese pop with a new jack swing beat and playful rap. A bright, cheeky young woman raps the verses in Japanese with bounce and attitude, and sings the catchy chorus herself with girl-group backing vocals. Swinging drum machine with hard snare hits and shuffled hi-hats, punchy synth bass, orchestra hit stabs, bright synth brass, funky clean guitar, handclaps. Fun, energetic, a night out in the city after missing the last train. Glossy digital studio production.
